purpose: The only ntotft > 1 gate in the suite. Three multi-fault bugs reached master and were each found only by a person running a new case by hand: accumulator aliasing reaching dtev, netcdf_write_on_fault reading 735 slots of uninitialised memory per file, and a fault plane falling between mesh lines so one fault got zero nodes while the run completed 4240 steps and reported 11 m of slip on a phantom single fault. This gate exists so the next one is caught by pytest instead.

fault_1.note: deliberately offset from fault 0 by 2 MPa so a swapped-fault or wrong-local-index read on either the Python (case.setup) or Fortran (netcdf_read_on_fault) side of the on_fault_vars_input.nc contract shows up as the wrong constant on the wrong fault's nodes rather than a value that happens to look plausible either way
